rule.question: Does option delta choice improve the robust entry/exits, rather than another day filter?
rule.pass: beat OWN parent in BOTH years, >=40 trades/year, positive without best day, positive after 200/trade; drawdown <=1.25 parent; not worse in >=3 of 4 halves; beat random median; no unresolved positions
rule.selection: per parent choose variant by worst stressed half on one year, score on other, both ways
rule.status: both years seen; no retuning; 2024 existing exam unchanged; no qualification or deployment
rule.limitations: target delta is a preference subject to available near-weekly strikes and shipped plan gates; no guarantee a 12500 cash account can afford the selected option; exact one-lot replay still required

limitations: 2025 and 2026 have already been seen; cross-year selection is diagnostic
minute close/spread model, not live executable quotes; fixed 65-unit current lot
stress holds trades fixed; does not replay cash/entry changes from worse prices
cash12500_week_proxy filters multi-lot parent trades, not exact one-lot portfolio replay
2024 and forward sessions untouched; no Production changes
